title: A record whose live delete the sync took leaves the id map, keeps its number used, and takes its copy-only rows along
steps: Run the live-sync-pushed cases for #307 (real MariaDB): a Joomla article the push made is deleted on live with the copy unchanged; the same with Tracy having changed it; a WordPress post with a copy-only revision and meta deleted on live.
expect: Taken delete: idMap has no content entry, idMapForgotten names it, jos_content AUTO_INCREMENT stays 2 or more, the copy-only versions are gone (orphansRemoved 2). Kept delete: the entry, the versions and the workflow row stay. WordPress: the post, its meta, terms and copy-only revision are gone.
evidence: Issue #307: content {1: 1} stayed in the id map, the next copy article took id 1 and was refused as live-record

tests: Joomla: an article a push made and the live site deleted for good leaves the id map
Joomla: an article the merge keeps
WordPress: a picture Tracy retitled and the live site deleted for good
